# Building the Website

Since this was my first time building a website, I followed the <a href="https://www.marvinschmitt.com/blog/website-tutorial-quarto/">tutorial</a> and template generously shared online by <a href="https://github.com/marvinschmitt/quarto-website-template/">Marvin Schmitt</a>. It gives a step-by-step with helpful explanations that anybody could follow.

I am still in the process of learning R and Github, so I played around with the template structure to get an idea of how things work in this environment. Doing so helped me understand the function of each component and become more confident with my coding. With each obstacle, I learned something new.
